# Hindi PDF Editor

> Hindi-first web editing and Android tools. Core edits run locally; optional AI OCR and translation send approved content for processing. Keep the source and review every export.

## Capabilities and limits

New Hindi text uses Unicode fonts and HTML shaping. The web export starts from the original file: unedited pages are copied unchanged, replaced text is removed from edited pages (or cleaned from scans) while table lines stay, and new words are added as images, so they are not searchable. Any edit invalidates a digital signature. Kruti Dev and DevLys pages are converted to Unicode and checked against the page image; other legacy fonts and unknown encodings block editing. The Unicode ↔ KrutiDev converter converts pasted text or a Word (.docx) file between Unicode and KrutiDev 010 in the browser, in both directions; in a Word file English words keep their own font, and KrutiDev → Unicode converts only text set in KrutiDev or DevLys fonts. Characters KrutiDev has no key for are kept and listed. Chanakya and other legacy fonts are not converted. Sign PDF adds a drawn, typed or uploaded signature as an image (an electronic signature, not a certificate-based digital signature) by hand, or on every page or chosen pages at a preset or dragged position, with each page's position adjustable on its own. Fill PDF form types Hindi or English answers into a PDF's own form fields (text, check boxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, list boxes); Hindi answers are drawn by the browser as the field's appearance and the typed text is kept as the field value. PDF to Word reads each page's text in the browser (the PDF's own text, Hindi from Chrome and Google Docs PDFs read from their ActualText, repaired Hindi, or OCR; OCR runs only on pages that need it by default, can be turned off or run on every page, and reads a limited number of pages per file depending on the device) into an editable .docx with paragraphs, sizes, headings and tables (ruled tables as Word tables with merged cells, scanned pages included; on digital pages, text lined up in columns without lines becomes a Word table without borders, while numbered paragraphs and lists stay paragraphs); text drawn as images is read with OCR; pictures (logos, photos, stamps) are placed in reading order; exact positions are not kept. Word to PDF lays out a .docx in the browser and saves page images (text not searchable; up to 300 pages) or prints to Save as PDF for selectable text. PDF to JPG draws each chosen page in the browser as a JPG or PNG image (up to 300 pages at a time); text in the images is not selectable. JPG to PDF puts up to 200 images into a new PDF, one per page, embedding JPG and PNG files unchanged and turning phone photos upright. Merge/split copy pages; compression rasterizes pages to JPEG and cannot guarantee a target file size. AI features require consent and enforce quotas. Editing an issued record does not authorize an official correction.

Privacy: https://hindipdfeditor.com/privacy/
Support: https://hindipdfeditor.com/support/

## Web and Android distinction

The Android app uses its documented Render & Print pipeline. The web editor removes replaced text from the original PDF and adds browser-shaped new words as images; unedited text stays selectable. Do not assume the two exports share selectability, signature preservation or file-size behavior. Test the fixed Devanagari fixture before relying on a new export change.
